_meta.description: Docudesk template registry for Shillinq. Templates are loaded via ConfigurationService::importFromApp() on install/upgrade. Each template declares the output-channel (openconnector source slug) for external submission.

templates.title: SiSa-bijlage Jaarrekening 2026
templates.description: Annual SiSa (Single Information Single Audit) bijlage rendered per BZK-vastgestelde layout for the 2026 controleprotocol. Groups SisaRegelingIndicator records by (regelingCode, controleprotocol) for the closed fiscal year. Missing verplicht: true indicatoren surface as warnings in the audit preview before submission per REQ-SISA-003.

outputChannel.description: BZK SiSa upload via openconnector source. Auth and protocol mapping are openconnector-side per ADR-019. Shillinq references by sourceSlug only.

auditEvent.description: Written by docudesk on every BZK submission attempt per REQ-SISA-005. Linked to the parent jaarrekening via audit-trail hash chain.

templateSections.title: Waarschuwingen ontbrekende verplichte indicatoren
templateSections.description: Lists verplicht: true indicatoren from the seeded controleprotocol that have no matching SisaRegelingIndicator record for the (regelingCode, fiscalYear).
